name: liu-xiaoyan-english
title_zh: 刘晓艳考研英语真题逐句精讲，不懂的句子当场拆给你看
tagline_zh: 备考最怕的是讲得四平八稳、听完什么也没记住。它模拟刘晓燕的教学腔：拆洋葱法看长难句、句型组装法写作文，已用 2026 年 6 月六级真题校准。
why_zh: 「绝对禁止」那节反着写：不许学术腔、不许翻译腔、不许「首先其次最后」。用规则把课讲得像人话，比堆知识点难。
limit_zh: 是教学风格的模拟，不是本人，方法论提炼自公开课程。押题和预测一概不做，真题校准只到 2026 年 6 月，之后的考纲变化它不知道。
tagline_en: The worst thing about test prep is a lesson so even-toned you remember none of it. This models a well-known Chinese exam coach's blunt classroom voice — peeling long sentences apart, assembling essays from patterns — calibrated against the June 2026 CET-6 paper.
why_en: Its 'absolutely forbidden' section is written in reverse: no academic register, no translationese, no 'firstly, secondly, finally'. Using rules to make a lesson sound human is harder than piling on content.
limit_en: A simulation of a teaching style, not the person; the method is drawn from public course material. It makes no predictions about what will be on the paper, and calibration stops at June 2026. Chinese English-exam context (CET/postgraduate).
title_en: Liu Xiaoyan-style English: every real-exam sentence broken.
